title: Free Realms Trading Card Game expansion
names_seen: Free Realms Trading Card Game expansion
Free Realms trading card game expansion

facts.statement: SOE announced an upcoming expansion to the Free Realms TCG and previewed several of its cards, saying it was 'almost here'.
facts.quote: we've got a sneak peek at a few of the cards you'll see with this exciting new set

facts.statement: A new Free Realms Trading Card Game expansion was released, with the Baron von Darkcheat storyline as its centrepiece.
facts.quote: Play the brand new expansion for the Free Realms Trading Card Game now!

facts.statement: A new expansion for the Free Realms collectible card game was released, centered on Baron Trampaoscura's plan to rule all the Realms.
facts.quote: ¡Juega la expansión nueva para el juego de cartas coleccionables Free Realms ahora!

facts.statement: Free Realms announced a new expansion for its Trading Card Game (JCC) that players could play immediately on the site.
facts.quote: Joue à la nouvelle extension du JCC de Free Realms dès maintenant!

facts.statement: A new expansion of the Free Realms trading card game (Sammelkartenspiel) was released and playable at the time of this post.
facts.quote: Spielt jetzt die brandneue Erweiterung des Free Realms Sammelkartenspiels!

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: A short SOE news post teasing an upcoming expansion (new set) for the Free Realms Trading Card Game. It shows art and sneak-peek images of new cards, including returning villain Baron Von Darkcheat, four new characters and several 'Heroes' cards, but gives no card names, release date or set name beyond saying a third expansion is coming. The post is a teaser, so it offers little mechanical detail.

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: A short promotional news page (headline 'Meet Free Realms' Newest Heroes', posted relative to capture date, no exact date shown) announcing a new expansion for the Free Realms Trading Card Game centred on Baron von Darkcheat, plus new in-game loot, a new Card Duelist questline and multi-color power-ups. The page gives no detailed mechanics, numbers or dates beyond these announcements; the locale table confirms the Baron and Card Duelist quest content of the expansion.

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language Free Realms news post (captured 2012-11-03, shown as posted 2 months, 6 days before capture, so the exact date is unknown) announcing a new expansion for the Free Realms trading card game. It names the villain Baron Trampaoscura, promises new in-game items, new card player quests and multicolor booster battles, and invites players to log in to see new Realms heroes. The post gives no numbers, prices or dates.

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - Quoi de neuf ?
article_summaries.summary: A short French-language promotional news page from freerealms.com announcing a new Free Realms Trading Card Game (JCC) expansion, with new loot, new card-player quests and multicolored boosts in combat. It gives no dates, numbers or item names. The post is relative-dated ('Publié il y a 2 mois, 6 jours') so its exact date cannot be recovered from the capture.

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: A German-language Free Realms news post (headline 'Trefft Free Realms neuste Helden', posted 2 months, 6 days before capture, so no absolute date) announcing a new expansion of the Free Realms trading card game. It says the expansion brings a new card-shop questline, new in-game loot items, and reinforcements with multiple colors. The client locale has no matches for the villain or questline names, so they are recorded without locale ids.
